title: Here's everything Apple announced at its big iPad and Mac event (AAPL) « Technology « MasMaz
text:
0 0 Share
NEW YORK CITY — Apple on Tuesday held its second big event of the fall in Brooklyn, New York’s most populous borough.
Apple held its first fall event in September, where it unveiled a new Apple Watch and three new iPhone models. On Tuesday, Apple showed off new iPad Pros, Mac computers, and more. Business Insider was in attendance to see it all happen live.
Here’s everything Apple announced at its big October event. 8:54 a.m.: The event took place at the Brooklyn Academy of Music. Apple dressed it all up for the big occasion. 9:09 a.m.: Plenty of Apple executives were in attendance, including Craig Federighi, aka “Hair Force One,” who oversees the development of Apple’s iPhone and Mac software. 9:25 a.m.: Thankfully, there was plenty of food to enjoy during the wait.
